round_interpretation: All 89 audited historical masks have complete three-seed results. The 16-input no-lag/no-MA/no-ERP parent has IC 0.319444, NLL -2.698793 and Sharpe 0.849882. The best-Sharpe point is larger and trades worse IC/NLL for a small Sharpe increase; the best-NLL anchor uses a different input family including lag. Existing exact neighbors already test adding MA, ERP, the gold/oil ratio and removing CPI monthly change. This round therefore targets eight previously untested individual removals, two coherent two-feature reductions, and two genuinely new rate/representation hypotheses. Do not force lag removal or confuse the old zero-filled credit history with proof against genuine HY inputs.
default_expected_tradeoff: Seek new Pareto regions or competitively smaller masks while preserving explicit IC/NLL/Sharpe tradeoffs. Report seed consistency and coverage; the three-ETF Sharpe differences must be interpreted alongside their dispersion.
default_falsification: A dominated result with no useful simplification fails the proposed removal or transfer in this context; it does not establish universal irrelevance of the input.

candidates.name: strong_ic_without_hy_level
candidates.hypothesis: A standardized HY state may suffice without the absolute spread level in this rich model; test the actual repaired OAS observations rather than the old zeros.

candidates.name: strong_ic_without_hy_zscore
candidates.hypothesis: The absolute HY spread may suffice without its trailing z-score; reciprocal removals distinguish complementary representations from redundant credit inputs.

candidates.name: strong_ic_without_cpi_year_change
candidates.hypothesis: The retained CPI monthly change and credit/risk state may make annual inflation redundant after ERP and MA have already been removed.

candidates.name: strong_ic_without_spy_flow
candidates.hypothesis: The signed-volume SPY flow proxy may add noise beyond market return, risk state and breadth in this international-debt context; earlier equity results do not settle the question.

candidates.name: strong_ic_without_long_momentum
candidates.hypothesis: Annual momentum and acceleration may retain the useful trend signal without the long 36-month horizon, which is now genuine throughout the common training panel.

candidates.name: strong_ic_without_momentum_acceleration
candidates.hypothesis: Annual and long-horizon momentum may substitute for acceleration in the broad macro model, potentially reducing local noise without forcing the same answer across families.

candidates.name: strong_ic_without_vix_slope_zscore
candidates.hypothesis: VIX level and slope may suffice without an additional standardized slope signal in this smaller no-ERP/no-MA context.

candidates.name: strong_ic_without_cross_sectional_rank
candidates.hypothesis: The global-universe momentum rank may be redundant with the remaining local momentum and macro state; testing it is necessary before calling it a shared core input.

candidates.name: strong_ic_with_vix_level_only
candidates.hypothesis: A VIX-level-only risk representation may retain most useful market-risk information while removing two related term-structure transforms.

candidates.name: strong_ic_without_both_hy_features
candidates.hypothesis: The market-risk and FX block might substitute for both HY representations, or this removal will establish why genuine credit observations are required; old zero-filled tests cannot answer it.

candidates.name: strong_ic_plus_nominal_yield_and_curve
candidates.hypothesis: USD nominal yield and curve state may add international-debt duration information absent from the historical credit/risk-heavy input family; test a coherent two-variable rate transfer.

candidates.name: strong_ic_with_shared_equity_local_basis
candidates.hypothesis: The same four-input local basis used by both equity families may support this debt family's macro model, providing a directly tested possible shared representation rather than a naive intersection of winners.
